Name: (Content Patcher) SVE Lance Spouse Patio and Earthy Recolour Fix
Author: brifoundthebingus
Description:
Lance's patio planter becomes transparent when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]. My sister and I ran into this on our save file after I married Lance, and this is my fix for an issue I saw previously discussed a handful of times in my search to find the cause. There isn't terribly much to say; it's a straightforward fix and I'm hoping to help other Lance enjoyers who like me would prefer to keep using the wonderful Earthy Recolour mod.

[b]As of version 1.1[/b], I have also added an EditMap action to this mod for those using Immersive Farm 2 Remastered alongside SVE and DNER. This places the SpouseAreaLocation tile property on the tile at 69, 6 on the farm map. This allows for Lance to go to his patio area, something I found he was not doing at all in our save file. He would never be there nor have dialogue relating to it, so I tested a fix and it worked out.

[b]For those not using IF2R[/b], there is a new config which will generate allowing you to disable this map edit by either unchecking the "IF2R" option in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or editing the file and setting "IF2R" to "false".

Big big thanks to the fine folks at the Stardew Valley Expanded and official Stardew Valley Discords for the past discussions which steered me in the right direction.[s]
[/s]
Install just like any other content pack.
